recent_lines: Three water bottles packed. Forgot to fill any of them.
The group slows for the café. I'm still on a KOM attempt.
Why do I always pick the hilliest route when my legs are already cooked?
Pretending the headwind doesn't count as extra climbing.
Nobody in the group mentioned this was a 'hilly' route.
When the group ride becomes "just a coffee" and we do 120km first.
The café is 8km away. I've been 'almost there' for 25 minutes.
I own four bikes. I ride the same one every time.
My legs were fine. I checked. Four times before leaving the house.
The climb looked shorter on Komoot. It always looks shorter on Komoot.
Signed up for the sportive eight months ago. Still haven't told my legs.
My Garmin has seen things I'll never admit to Strava.
Third café stop "just for water." The route adds itself.
Why do I always pick the hilly route "for recovery"?
Half-wheeling me since 2019. Still call him my training partner.
